limitations: G1 counts cover cross-module connected sets up to 4 composite nodes only; zero means not represented in that index, not proof no opportunity.
G5 counts cover individual partial templates; source graphs, aliasing, consumers, dynamic branches, and primitive expansions remain incomplete.
Counts establish structural inclusion only, not equivalence, feasibility, materialization savings, or global exhaustion.
G1 and G5 overlap in semantic scope; do not sum counts as unique opportunities.
Same-template edge with an external producer/consumer may intentionally be excluded from internal candidate sets and is marked UNKNOWN.
